title: Run-length encoding
task: Implement encode(s) and decode(s) in rle.py for run-length encoding: encode('aaabcc') is '3a1b2c' and decode reverses it. encode's input is letters only. Add tests.
follow_up: Review finding: runs of ten or more are mishandled: encode('a' * 12) must be '12a' and decode('12a') must give it back. Also decode must raise ValueError for malformed input such as 'a', '3', '0a' or '3a2'. Add tests.
